SD68-X01.name: The SunConcluserDragon Apollonia-Vern
SD68-X01.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Apollon" & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[Unleash: 2] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest BP, and for each symbol on the destroyed target, send an opposing Life to the Trash. By sending two cores from your Red Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, this destruction effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks)
Once per turn, you can negate an opposing active White Magic/[Accel] effect, other than on-field effects.

SD68-003.name: Folk-StarDragon
SD68-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a non-Cost 4 "Astral Dragon"/"Olym" family card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Hand increases via your "Astral Dragon"/"Olym" family effect, you can destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. For each core on all your "Contractor Apollon" combined, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +2000.

SD68-005.name: Star Dragon Draw
SD68-005.effect:
[Main]
Draw a card. Then, you can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add either an "Apollon" Grandwalker Nexus card, or a "Concluser" family Spirit card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

SD68-006.name: Star Dust Flame
SD68-006.effect:
When this card was sent to the Trash from deck by your "Apollon" Grandwalker Nexus' effect, you can add it to the Hand. When you've done so, you can +1 core to any Red Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[Flash]
Destroy either an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing 15000 BP or less Ultimate. If you control any "Contractor Apollon", increase the limit of this "BP Destruction effect" by +10000.

SD68-004.name: The ArdentStarDragon Zon-Balphard
SD68-004.effect:
When this card is revealed by the [Contract Field] of your “Contractor Apollon”, you can summon it by paying one cost.

[Burst: After your Spirit/Nexus is destroyed by the Opponent]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. When summoned via an effect, this “BP Destruction effect” ignores “BP+” and “give + BP” effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

SD68-CX01.name: The FlameWheelContractor Apollon
SD68-CX01.effect:
[Neo-Core Charge:: (Astral Dragon/Devotee/Concluser & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When your target Spirit is summoned, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this Nexus is deployed, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Revive] Main - (Once per Turn: Same Name) You can deploy this card from Soul State.

2 [LV1][LV2] Flash -
(Once per turn, send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Your counters +2. Then, if it's the Attack Step, ignoring "BP+" and "give +BP" effects, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[Contract Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your "Astral Dragon" family Spirit attacks, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If it's a "Devotee"/"Concluser" family card, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Add the revealed card to the Hand.

SD68-001.name: The SunDragon Drago-Sole
SD68-001.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State, if you control any "Contractor Apollon", you can summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, you can deploy one of your "Contractor Apollon" from Soul State, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with one symbol or less.

SD68-007.name: The Tower of Darkness
SD68-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
Neither player can [Advent], nor can they summon Spirit cards without paying the cost besides via Burst effects.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Nexus's color and symbol are also treated as Red.

SD68-002.name: Tribe-StarDragon
SD68-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Nexus. When you've done so, draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. By sending a core from any of your "Apollon" Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, this effect draws +1 card.
